post.description: Exchanges the httpOnly refresh cookie for a new access token.

patch.description:
Region, locale and theme in one call.

Theme lives here rather than only in a cookie so the choice follows the
user across devices.

get.description:
Both directions in one payload.

Tombstoned nodes stay in the graph so the chain is never visibly broken.

Field-by-field comparison against the parent version.

Powers the "what changed" panel in the lineage graph.

schema.title: Response Get Edge V1 Lineage Edges  Edge Id  Get

post.description: Starts a draft, capturing the source licence at this moment.

Publishes a draft as one transaction.

Everything from the licence re-check to the ancestor notification either
lands together or not at all.
Price preview. Must be shown before any credits are committed.

Submits a job: quote, reserve, enqueue.

Credits are reserved inside this transaction so the user cannot queue more
work than they can pay for, even by submitting in parallel.

Requests cancellation.

A job already at the provider may still complete; settlement follows the
real outcome rather than the request.

Resubmits a failed job as a new one.

A new job (rather than reopening the old one) keeps the ledger honest: the
first attempt's release and the retry's reserve stay separate records.

get.description:
Server-sent progress stream.

On reconnect the client sends `Last-Event-ID` and receives every missed
event from the database before the live tail resumes, so no progress step
is ever silently skipped.
The spec catalogue the studio renders its selector and limits from.

post.description: Checks one clip and its caption against a spec, rule by rule.
把画面描述交给文案 Agent 润色，保留用户核心意图。

Records an export intent and returns the material to post with.

Direct publishing is not implemented; the intent exists so the history is
already there when it is.

schema.title: Response List Characters V1 Characters Get
Response List Series V1 Series Get

post.description:
Issues a scoped upload URL.

The signature is bound to one key, MIME type and content length, so it
cannot be reused to write anything else into the bucket.
Verifies the stored object against what was promised, then registers it.

get.description: Returns the AI disclosure claim attached to a generated asset.

post.description: Cashes in an invite/promo code for its face-value credits.

Creates a payment intent.

No credits are granted here. Only a verified webhook turns a payment into
balance, so a user who abandons checkout is never charged or credited.

Books a settled payment.

Three separate protections apply: HMAC signature over the raw body, a
timestamp window against replay, and a unique event id so repeated delivery
of a genuine event credits the account exactly once.

Saves reusable parameters.

A preset derived from someone else's work only stores parameters the source
licence actually exposed, so it cannot leak a private prompt.

按 `push_token` upsert：重装 App 换新 token 会插新行，旧 token 静默失效——
不主动清理旧行，靠 APNs 返回的 Unregistered 反馈去删（该反馈通道本地环境用不上）。

get.description: Re-reads the session so the console can render RBAC-aware navigation.
What the router actually sees when it scores candidates.
Replays the decision candidate by candidate, including rejects.

The declared pipeline for one operation, used to render a timeline
even for a job that failed before emitting its later steps.

schema.title: Response Workflow Shape V1 Admin Workflow Get

get.description:
Throughput for the statistics hub: status/operation mix and how long a
succeeded job actually takes, over a rolling window.

Declared before `/jobs/{job_id}` so FastAPI's path matching does not treat
`stats` as a job id.
Everything needed to explain one job after the fact.

post.description:
Forces a stuck job into a terminal state.

The move still goes through the state machine, so a job that finished a
moment earlier is not overwritten, and reserved credits are returned to the
user unless the operator explicitly keeps them held.

Re-dispatches a job whose worker died before reaching a terminal state.

Only non-terminal jobs qualify; replaying a finished job would risk a second
capture against the same reservation.

get.description: Highest priority first; ties broken by age so nothing starves.

The queue row plus its full verdict trail, so a reviewer can see what
already happened to this subject before deciding whether to reverse it.

post.description: Assigns an item so two reviewers do not duplicate work.

Records a human verdict.

The agent's original verdict is never edited: a reviewer adds a new
`ModerationResult` row that supersedes it, so the disagreement stays on the
record.
Removes a work from circulation without breaking descendant lineage.
Reversible removal from discovery, unlike a tombstone.
Undoes a hide. A tombstone is final and cannot be restored here.

get.description:
Assets sharing an identical perceptual hash.

Exact matches only. Near-duplicate scanning by Hamming distance is a
separate, heavier job and is not run from a request handler.

post.description:
Replaces the role set.

Only an admin can reach this, and an admin cannot strip their own admin
role — that is the classic way to lock everyone out of the console.

Approves or rejects an export or deletion request.

Approving a deletion anonymises the account but keeps lineage tombstones, so
descendants can still resolve their provenance.

get.description: The stored snapshot, or a fresh one on demand.

Reservations that never became a capture or a release.

This is the direct read-out of the "a reserve always settles" invariant, so
a non-empty list means a settlement path was missed somewhere.

post.description:
Manual correction.

Nothing is ever edited: this appends an `adjustment` row carrying the
operator's identity and reason, so the history stays reconstructible.

No way back once flipped — there is no `activate` endpoint — so this
carries the same reason + confirm gate as minting a code does.

put.description:
Validates, versions and activates a new value.

Validation happens before the write, so an invalid weight is rejected at
edit time rather than surfacing later inside a worker.

get.description: Flattened field-by-field comparison of two versions.

post.description:
Re-applies an earlier version as a new one.

Moving forward to a copy keeps both the mistake and its correction in the
history, which is what the audit trail is for.
Publishes a notice, optionally fanning it out as in-app notifications.

put.description:
Creates or replaces one endpoint. `api_key=None` keeps the stored secret.

Demotion happens automatically rather than being rejected, because each
`kind` has exactly one primary node by definition: saving with
`role="primary"` demotes whichever other endpoint of the same `kind`
currently holds it. The demotion is recorded on the same audit entry so
it stays traceable.

post.description:
Removing the endpoint another agent's traffic depends on is the kind of
mistake that stops generations from completing, hence the confirmation.

Publishes a new prompt version for one node and makes it active.

A rejected or unparseable safety verdict is the direct, immediate result
of what this prompt says, so publishing it is treated with the same
confirmation ceremony as any other dangerous admin action.
Rolls back to an earlier version by re-publishing its content.

get.description:
The whitelist an operator drags nodes from — there is no way to add a
type from the console; every entry here shipped in a code review.

post.description:
Structural pre-check so the editor can flag a broken graph before an
operator spends a confirmation dialog on it.

put.description:
Publishes a new version of one operation's graph and makes it active.

A published graph decides the real execution path of every job submitted
from now on, so it carries the same confirmation ceremony as any other
dangerous admin action.

post.description: Rolls back by re-publishing an earlier version's graph as a new one.

Simulates a job through the operation's *active* published graph.

Never creates a `GenerationJob` row, reserves credits, or hits a paid
provider — see `WorkflowContext.dry_run` and every node executor's own
`if ctx.dry_run` branch for the specifics. The four agent nodes
(safety/planning/intent_router/quality) still call the real LLM gateway
on purpose: that is the one thing worth spending a little real cost on to
actually validate a prompt change before publishing it.
Applies the standard retention rules to the bucket.

Runs `pg_dump` and stores the archive in object storage.

Synchronous on purpose: an operator triggering a backup before a risky
change needs to know whether it actually succeeded.
Loads demo data. Refused outright in production.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: 正数为补发，负数为扣回。

AdminJobDetail.title: AdminJobDetail
AdminJobDetail.description: Full replay material for one job.

AgentNodeView.title: AgentNodeView
AgentNodeView.description:
One pipeline stage plus which failover-pool endpoints could serve it.

`candidate_endpoint_ids` is derived, not stored: it is whichever
`llm_providers` endpoints are enabled `kind="general"` endpoints — every
agent role shares that one pool now — so the node graph can show "0
candidate endpoints" as an actionable warning rather than a silent gap.

CreationSkillSummary.title: CreationSkillSummary
CreationSkillSummary.description: 列表卡片投影，风格对齐 `learning.LearnPostSummary`。

CreationSkillVisibility.title: CreationSkillVisibility
CreationSkillVisibility.description:
Owner's intent, independent of moderation state.

A `PENDING_REVIEW`/`REJECTED` skill can carry `PUBLIC` here (it is meant
for sharing) while still being invisible to anyone but its owner — public
listing always additionally filters on `status == PUBLISHED`.

DangerousAction.title: DangerousAction
DangerousAction.description:
Base for anything requiring a typed reason.

The reason is stored in the audit log, so an empty string is refused at the
schema boundary rather than deep inside a service.

DistributionChannel.title: DistributionChannel
DistributionChannel.description:
Where an export is headed.

`MANUAL_DOWNLOAD` is the only channel that completes today; `DOUYIN` names
the destination so an intent recorded now stays meaningful once direct
publishing exists.

GatewayStatusResponse.title: GatewayStatusResponse
GatewayStatusResponse.description: Aggregate health of the generation gateway.

JobStatsView.title: JobStatsView
JobStatsView.description: Aggregate job throughput for the statistics hub — not one job's detail.

LearnPostDecisionRequest.title: LearnPostDecisionRequest
LearnPostDecisionRequest.description: `reason` 拒绝时必填，通过时忽略——校验放在 domain 层，见 `learning.service.reject`。

LearnPostDetail.title: LearnPostDetail
LearnPostDetail.description:
详情比列表卡片多带 `cover_asset_id`：编辑表单回填封面时如果只拿得到
`cover_url`，用户不重新选图提交就会把封面字段整份覆盖成空。

`body_markdown` 里的图片用 `learn-asset:{id}` 这种不过期的引用而不是直出
URL（对象存储的签名 URL 会过期，不能写进持久化的正文）；`asset_urls` 是
服务端在这次响应里临时解析出的 `{资产 id: 当下有效的签名 URL}` 映射，只给
渲染/编辑时替换显示用，不代表存储格式变了。

LearnPostSummary.title: LearnPostSummary
LearnPostSummary.description: 列表卡片投影，风格对齐 `works.WorkSummary`。

LedgerEntryType.title: LedgerEntryType
LedgerEntryType.description:
Append-only ledger vocabulary.

`RESERVE` is negative available / positive reserved; `CAPTURE` settles it;
`RELEASE` returns it. `ROYALTY_OUT` / `ROYALTY_IN` move credits from a
remixer to ancestor authors.

LifecycleStatus.title: LifecycleStatus
LifecycleStatus.description: A work is never hard-deleted; descendants must stay resolvable.

LineageResponse.title: LineageResponse
LineageResponse.description: Both directions in one payload so the graph renders in a single fetch.

LlmProviderCategoryView.title: LlmProviderCategoryView
LlmProviderCategoryView.description:
Legacy category projection; the console now renders a flat endpoint
list from `LlmProviderPoolView.endpoints`. Kept so older clients do not
break on an unexpected schema change.

LlmProviderEndpointView.title: LlmProviderEndpointView
LlmProviderEndpointView.description:
Read model for one model-provider endpoint.

`api_key` itself never appears here — only whether one is set and a
truncated preview — so a GET response is always safe to render or log.

`role`/`backup_order` are endpoint-level for both `general` and `media`.
For media, `capabilities` only declares which tags the credential serves
and which model id each tag uses.

LogEntryView.title: LogEntryView
LogEntryView.description:
One row in the unified log centre: an `AuditLog` row (privileged writes)
or a `SystemLog` row (auth/rate-limit/permission signals), reshaped onto a
common shape so the console can filter and scroll through both together.

MediaCapabilityView.title: MediaCapabilityView
MediaCapabilityView.description:
One media capability (e.g. `text_to_image`) an endpoint serves.

Used both to read and to write: it carries no secret, so the same shape
works for the upsert request and the response. Primary/backup role lives
on the parent endpoint, not here.

ModerationHistoryEntry.title: ModerationHistoryEntry
ModerationHistoryEntry.description: One row from the append-only verdict trail for a subject.

ModerationSubjectDetailView.title: ModerationSubjectDetailView
ModerationSubjectDetailView.description:
Full context for one queue item: the current decision plus everything
that led to it, so a reviewer can judge a REJECTED/HIDDEN call without
trusting the summary row alone.

NodeTypeView.title: NodeTypeView
NodeTypeView.description:
One entry in the admin-facing node palette.

`config_schema` is the node type's Pydantic config model rendered as a
JSON Schema, so the editor can generate its property-panel form without a
hand-maintained mirror of `app.workflows.configs`.

PreferencesRequest.title: PreferencesRequest
PreferencesRequest.description: Partial update; every field is optional.

ProvenanceResponse.title: ProvenanceResponse
ProvenanceResponse.description:
AI disclosure for a generated asset.

`signed` is false until a real C2PA signer is configured; the claim is
still worth showing, but it must not be presented as verified.

PublicationStatus.title: PublicationStatus
PublicationStatus.description:
Lifecycle of one distribution intent.

Nothing reaches `SUBMITTED` yet: it belongs to the OAuth direct-publish path
that is deliberately left unimplemented, together with `FAILED`.

RedemptionCodeCreateRequest.title: RedemptionCodeCreateRequest
RedemptionCodeCreateRequest.description:
Confirmation + a written reason, like `AdjustCreditsRequest` — minting
a code is a direct promise of real credits.

RedemptionCodeKind.title: RedemptionCodeKind
RedemptionCodeKind.description:
`INVITE` is meant for one-to-one referral (small `max_uses`, often 1);
`PROMO` is an operator-run campaign code shared with many users at once.

ReusableParams.title: ReusableParams
ReusableParams.description:
What a remixer can carry over.

Only fields the author actually made reusable appear here; a licence that
forbids derivatives yields an empty payload.

ShortformProfileResponse.title: ShortformProfileResponse
ShortformProfileResponse.description:
One delivery spec, flattened so the client can validate locally.

The same numbers drive the server-side checks, so a client that enforces
them is only saving a round trip, never defining the rule.

TagResponse.title: TagResponse
TagResponse.description:
A tag with all three labels.

The client picks the label for its own locale rather than the server
guessing from a header, so one cached response serves every language.

Visibility.title: Visibility
Visibility.description: Publication scope. `PUBLIC_VIEW_ONLY` is the mandated default.

WorkSummary.title: WorkSummary
WorkSummary.description: Card-sized projection used by discover, profile and collection lists.
